title: Final Cross Section
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the final expression for the scattering cross section sigma.

title: Dependence of Alpha
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately describe how alpha depends on the nuclear charge Z.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the correct integration steps for calculating the scattering amplitude f.

title: Spherical Symmetry
description: Important Criteria: The student must recognize and apply the spherical symmetry of the potential V(r) in the integration.

title: Momentum Transfer
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly express the momentum transfer q in terms of k and k0.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the scattering amplitude or incorrect limits of integration.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Alternative Approaches
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention any alternative methods or approximations that could be used to solve the problem.
